text:
## Step 6: Modify Standing Order  
### Changes Allowed  
Customer can modify:
- ✅ **Amount:** Change payment amount (creates new SO, cancels old)
- ✅ **Frequency:** Change timing (weekly → monthly, etc.)
- ✅ **Payee:** Change recipient (creates new SO, cancels old)
- ✅ **End Date:** Set or change end date

raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure enabling customers to modify existing standing orders by changing payment amount, frequency, payee, or end date. Modifications to amount or payee trigger cancellation of the old standing order and creation of a new one.
context: Customer can modify: Amount, Frequency, Payee, End Date

raw_entities.name: Amount Modification
raw_entities.description: Customer initiates a change to the payment amount of an existing standing order. This action triggers cancellation of the old standing order and creation of a new standing order with the updated amount.
context: Change payment amount (creates new SO, cancels old)
Amount: Change payment amount

raw_entities.name: Frequency Modification
raw_entities.description: Customer modifies the payment frequency or timing of the standing order, such as changing from weekly to monthly payments. The existing standing order remains active with updated frequency parameters.
context: Change timing (weekly → monthly, etc.)
Frequency: Change timing

raw_entities.name: Payee Modification
raw_entities.description: Customer changes the recipient or payee of the standing order. This modification triggers cancellation of the old standing order and creation of a new standing order with the updated payee details.
context: Change recipient (creates new SO, cancels old)
Payee: Change recipient

raw_entities.description: Customer sets or changes the end date of the standing order, defining when the recurring payment instruction will cease.
